judgments.reason: The dataset README names this eLife 2019 Stolk et al. paper as its source study. It reports the movement-imagery ECoG data, and the dataset shares a subset of its participants (S4-S6).
judgments.paper_title: Electrocorticographic dissociation of alpha and beta rhythmic activity in the human sensorimotor system

judgments.reason: Nature Protocols paper describes a general protocol for integrating anatomical and electrophysiological intracranial data, a method used in analysis, not this dataset's data paper (that is Stolk 2019 eLife).
judgments.paper_title: Integrated analysis of anatomical and electrophysiological human intracranial data
